disclose: The release has an empty GPOS table (scripts DFLT, hani, latn with no features or lookups) that FontForge wrote because GSUB has lookups; its presence turns off HarfBuzz's fallback mark positioning. fontc cannot write a GPOS without lookups, so here combining marks are placed by the fallback and differ from the release. Needs a fontc option (shared layout scripts); planned as later work. Decided 2026-10-02: disclose.
